datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.intro: Each upload becomes a dataset. Cleaning it creates a new version and keeps the original.
datasets.emptyBody: Upload a CSV or Excel file of your sales or orders. We'll check its health and suggest fixes before any analysis.

needs.kpis: It needs a revenue column, or quantity and price.

needs.cohort_retention: It needs a customer id, a date and several months of orders.
needs.forecast: It needs a date column and at least two years of revenue to learn the seasons.
needs.anomalies: It needs a date column and a few months of daily sales.
needs.segmentation: It needs a customer id, a date and revenue for enough customers.
needs.churn: It needs a customer id, order dates and enough repeat buyers over a year or more.
